description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waththala, Waththala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512000 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and property ownership matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their owners, property details, encumbrances, and legal determinations regarding land titles. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
